scope: Prospective numerical whole-factory development necessity screen, not independent application confirmation
timed: Factory and three RNG constructions, original supplied piecewise-GMP callback execution, level selection, actual source calls, all vote/proposal/arithmetic/refinement/cache work and returned-output allocation
outside_api_timer: Common module imports and immutable case metadata, process startup, laboratory JSON serialization/logging; separately report worker wall/CPU including imports/startup/I/O and peak RSS
order: Protocol order of functions,p,operations; each repetition rotates method order by (case ordinal + repetition) modulo eligible count
cpu: Pin parent and child to first CPU already allowed by sched_getaffinity; record actual affinity and hardware/runtime
correctness: No clipping/restarts; assert integer output/source counts and preserve all records including failures. Same-law core methods must match source/level n,k,level and input tape hash; direct source counts legitimately differ.
win: All five paired repetitions COMPLETE for sparse and EVERY eligible control. For each control both medians of paired sparse/control API wall and CPU ratios <=0.8, and every ratio <1 for both clocks. Failures never provide favorable evidence.
followup_necessity_gate: At least three of six nonpolynomial function/p cases win within at least one operation. Polynomial controls and both operations are always reported. This gate only permits separately justified real-application/independent protocol; it never completes novelty/usefulness/publication goal.
if_negative: Close this fixed numerical application at this criterion; no more seeds/degrees/functions, manufactured costly f or changed threshold to rescue it. Preserve mathematical cap and all controls. Any different direction requires its own useful consequence and criteria before expansion.
